Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning assisted living facility medicaid minimum occupancy of fifty percent or greater.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assisted living facility medicaid minimumoccupancy percentage of fifty percent or greater; and adding a newsection to chapter 74.39A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall establish a capital addon rate, not less thanthe July 1, 2005, capital addon rate established by the department,for those assisted living facilities contracting with the departmentthat have a medicaid minimum occupancy percentage of fifty percent orgreater. The medicaid minimum occupancy percentage shall be determinedon an annual basis.
